correctness.rationale: The root-block generating function and Lagrange inversion prove Kreweras full block-profile enumeration. Ordering blocks conditional on K=k gives a uniform positive composition. Exact first- and second-moment binomial ratios yield the factorized sign criterion and all boundary cases. An unconditional mixed-moment extraction and displayed square-plus-positive-polynomial identity establish strict negativity for every n. The fixed-r asymptotic limits follow from binomial ratios. The standalone exact verifier passed 2,074,703 assertions, including all noncrossing partitions through n=10 and symbolic identities through n=160; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: Unlike a routine covariance evaluation, the exact threshold rk=2(n-1) provides a global parameterized conditional phase diagram with exceptional boundaries and a genuinely dependent zero-covariance instance. Strict marginal negativity at every n contrasts with conditional positive covariance of linear order n for every fixed r≥5 at the typical block count, exhibiting a robust conditioning-induced sign reversal relevant to random noncrossing structures.
